info.title: RealityOS API
info.description: Evidence-first spatial memory. Query routes never create captures.

post.description:
Issue a short-lived, real device identity for Meta's virtual glasses.

The route exists so the APK can show usable live values without committing a
permanent device key. The reverse proxy rate-limits this public bootstrap
endpoint and all issued identities remain scoped to one configured workspace.

get.description: Return the enrolled device's locations without exposing other workspaces.

get.description:
Return only jobs created from a capture session owned by this device.

Device credentials are deliberately narrower than a workspace membership:
a device may observe its own upload's processing state, but never another
device's capture history, even when both are assigned to the same workspace.

post.description: Explicitly refine one verified evidence item; Query users cannot invoke this.
Identify an object from an ephemeral image, then query existing evidence only.

Decide whether a captured probe looks like a person, an object, or is
ambiguous. Probe bytes stay ephemeral; detection boxes are never stored.

Route free text to person search, object search, or a clarifying question.

Ephemeral: the text is classified and never stored as a query or capture.

get.description:
Serve one short-lived highlighted image to the DAT Display renderer.

DAT Display fetches image URLs itself, so it cannot send the encrypted
device credential held by the Android host. The signed token is deliberately
limited to this observation and the still-active enrolled device.
Compatibility endpoint; queries now use an observation-specific overlay.

post.description: Speak caller-supplied response text; never look up evidence or capture media.

get.description: Newest-first chat page for the authenticated profile (guests included).

post.description: Attach one voice segment to an owned chat turn for later playback.
Join consecutive transcript chunks, dropping boundary repetitions.
Create or resume the guest user bound to one device identifier.
Transcribe a mobile voice note to text. Audio bytes are never stored.

get.description:
Ephemeral overlay: unfilled boxes around matched AI detections.

full_size preserves the original image dimensions for the viewer.
The original BYTEA is never modified. Videos fall back to the plain
thumbnail because frame-indexed boxes have no single still to annotate.

post.description: Explicit recovery action for missing historical translations; Query stays read-only.

Draw numbered color boxes over an uploaded probe for the Display.

The probe is never stored as media: only the rendered card is cached in
memory until its short-lived token expires.

Check the selfie against the account's Facebook faces.

Failures stay in place for direct retry with a new photo; after
``face_max_attempts`` failures the account locks for
``face_lockout_minutes``. A success resets the failure chain.
